status.summary: Huizhou University is procuring a modular data-centre room, refurbishment and an 800 kVA electrical supply package as part of its campus-network upgrade. The amended schedule lists CNY 3,245,895.53 for the modular room and CNY 846,981.98 for refurbishment; the electrical rating is not IT capacity. The October 15 amendment moves bidding to November 2. Construction and operation of this upgrade have not been confirmed.

additions.successor_review: October 15 amendment identifies the same HZSF-2026-015 project as the September 30 university tender and retains other original provisions. This is procurement for physical modular-room and electrical infrastructure, not a software-only data platform. Existing-infrastructure upgrade language does not establish current room operations. The future contract periods overlap (service begins in April 2027 while the construction period extends to August 2027); no exact opening is inferred. The university campus is explicitly named but service placement is subject to purchaser designation, so the locator remains campus context only. Exact-title/domain searches found only the original and amendment, with no achieved start, completion or opening.
